thread.title: Dow erases triple-digit stumble to momentarily turn positive in intraday action - MarketWatch

author: Mark DeCambre
title: Dow erases triple-digit stumble to momentarily turn positive in intraday action - MarketWatch
text:
The Dow Jones Industrial Average wiped out a triple-digit slide to pivot in to the green on Friday, with shares of Apple Inc. AAPL, +0.50% and Exxon Mobil Corp. XOM, +1.12% helping offset a slide in shares of Boeing Co. BA, -1.68% The Dow DJIA, -0.47% traded flat at 25,995 at 25,993, with Boeing's decline 2.5% tempering a slide in shares of Apple and Exxon, with each climbing by at least 1%. The Dow had been down by as many as 107.45 points at Friday's lows, following the August jobs report. Meanwhile, the S&P 500 index SPX, -0.18% and the Nasdaq Composite Index COMP, +0.10% were both trading in positive territory after opening firmly lower.
